CustomField.description: How many tool-calling iterations AIAgentManager allows per AI message when the AI Agent's own Max Tool Calling Iterations is blank. Always clamped to Max Tool Calling Iterations Cap. Blank or below 1 falls back to the code default (5).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Used when an AI Agent has no Max Tool Calling Iterations set. Clamped to Max Tool Calling Iterations Cap.
CustomField.label: Default Max Tool Calling Iterations
